comments.author: @NikolaKnezevic-r5j
comments.text: If I hadn't actually been in Sweden back in the day (1990–1991)—specifically in Märsta, right near Arlanda Airport—I’d just be guessing! As it stands, I can speak with certainty, and my account definitely holds water... Swedes are a lively people—they know how to live well and please both themselves and others! Swedish women are incredibly spirited, attractive, charismatic, alluring, hot, and erotic... women who are very hard to resist! Respect, Nikola Knezevic (59 years old; born October 25, 1967, in Belgrade, Serbia; spent the last 12 years with my family—my wife, 50, and our 15-year-old daughter—seeking asylum in Metz, France, with our status still unresolved). We wish all Swedish men and women wonderful moments and the little things that give life meaning and make it even more beautiful than it already is!
